newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - gas oil dips, fuel oil rises.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil dips, fuel oil rises.

text.p: NWE oil products opened mixed on Friday morning. Gas oil softened with futures while fuel oil rose slightly, dealers said.
Heating oil barges lost $1 a tonne as IPE August gas oil futures dipped. Prompt and first half August delivery offers remained at August IPE +$1.50.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were still offered at $90 fob Rotterdam, but bids rose from $88 to $89/$89.50 with signs of building demand.
